help.pageSubtitle: Quick usage guide for each part of the system

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.intro: A few basics before using the system.
steps: Sign in with your assigned email and password.
Choose your display language (VI / EN / 中文) in the top-right corner — your choice is remembered for next time.
From the Home page, click the card for the module you need.
Click the Help icon (❓) on any page to come back here, jumped straight to the relevant section.

demoAccounts.title: Demo Accounts
demoAccounts.intro: Use these to sign in as different roles while testing the system.

goodsReceipt.title: Goods Receipt
goodsReceipt.intro: Use this when receiving goods from a supplier into the warehouse.
steps: Go to Goods Receipt → click Create New.
Select the warehouse and supplier, fill in PO / Packing List / Invoice numbers if available.
Add each line: select the item, enter the lot code and quantity.
Click Create — the receipt is saved as Draft and does not yet affect stock.
Open the new receipt and click Submit.
The Department Head (or Admin) approves it — once approved, the system automatically creates a Lot and updates stock.
After approval, click "View QR" on each line to print a tag for the physical goods.

qc.title: QC — Quality Inspection
qc.intro: Required before an item is allowed to be issued from stock.
steps: Go to QC → Create New Inspection → select the lot to inspect (only lots awaiting inspection are shown).
Choose a preliminary result: Passed / Partially Passed / Failed.
You must take and upload at least one photo before submitting — the system blocks submission without one.
Click Submit.
The QC Manager (or Admin) approves it — the lot's status updates accordingly; only Passed / Partially Passed lots can be issued.

issueRequest.title: Issue
issueRequest.intro: Anyone can create a request; it goes through 2 approval levels before warehouse staff release the stock.
steps: Go to Issue → Create New Request → select the warehouse, add items and quantities needed.
Click Submit.
The requester's Department Head approves at level 1.
The BOD approves at level 2.
Warehouse staff click Issue — the system automatically picks the lot expiring soonest first (FEFO).
If stock is insufficient, the system still issues what's available instead of blocking the whole request.

transfer.title: Warehouse Transfer
transfer.intro: Use this when moving stock between two different warehouses within the company.
steps: Go to Warehouse Transfer → Create New → select source warehouse, destination warehouse, lot and quantity.
Source warehouse staff click Confirm Ship.
Destination warehouse staff click Confirm Receive.
While awaiting receipt confirmation, the goods are marked "in transit" — stock is never lost from the total.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: View current stock and transaction history, and export to Excel.
steps: "Current Stock" tab — view the quantity on hand for each item/warehouse.
"Transaction History" tab — view individual transactions (receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments), filterable by type/date.
Click "Export Excel" on either tab to download a file.

stocktakeManagement.title: Stocktake
stocktakeManagement.intro: Count physical stock and reconcile against the system quantity per lot.
steps: Go to Stocktake → click Start New Stocktake → select the warehouse to count.
The system automatically snapshots current stock per lot and locks that warehouse's Receipt/Issue/Transfer transactions while counting is in progress.
Enter the actual counted quantity for each line — either type it directly on a computer, or use your phone to scan QR tags for faster counting (see "QR Scan Stocktake" below).
Once every line is counted, click Complete Stocktake — the system automatically adjusts stock to match the counted quantities.
If any line's variance exceeds the allowed tolerance, the system blocks completion — only Admin can override and complete, with a mandatory reason.

disposalHelp.title: Defect Disposal
disposalHelp.intro: Use this when a lot has been marked "Failed" at QC and needs to be disposed of through the proper process.
steps: Go to Defect Disposal → Create New Disposal Request → select the lot (only Failed lots are shown), select the warehouse, enter quantity and reason.
Click Create — the lot automatically moves to "Pending Disposition" status, temporarily locked from use elsewhere.
Open the new request and click Submit.
QA (QC Manager) gives level-1 approval.
The Board of Directors gives the final approval — once approved, the system automatically deducts stock and marks the lot as "Disposed".
If rejected at either level, the lot automatically reverts to "Failed" status — a new disposal request can be created, or another course of action taken (e.g. return to supplier).

leaveHelp.title: Leave Request
leaveHelp.intro: Use this to request time off (annual, unpaid, sick...).
steps: Go to Leave Request → Create New Request → select leave type, date range, enter reason.
Click Create — the request is saved as Draft, not yet sent to anyone.
Open the new request and click Submit.
Your direct manager (Department Head) gives level-1 approval.
HR gives the final approval — once approved, the status changes to Approved.
You can Cancel the request any time before it's fully approved.

overtimeHelp.title: Overtime
overtimeHelp.intro: Use this to register an overtime plan for a group of employees in the same department.
steps: Go to Overtime → Create New Plan → select date, time range, reason, and check the employees participating (only same-department employees are shown).
Click Create — saved as Draft.
Open the new plan and click Submit.
Direct manager approves at level 1, HR gives final approval — same flow as Leave Request.

mealHelp.title: Meal Registration
mealHelp.intro: Register your meal per day — no approval needed, takes effect immediately.
steps: Go to Meal Registration → select the date, check Lunch and/or Overtime Meal.
Click Register/Update — takes effect immediately, no approval needed.
To change your selection: pick the same date again, adjust the checkboxes, click Register/Update — the system overwrites your previous choice.
To cancel entirely: select the date and click Cancel Meal for This Day.
You can only register/edit/cancel for today or a future date — not for a past date.

gatepassHelp.title: Gate Pass
gatepassHelp.intro: Use this when you need to go out during work hours, or enter the company outside normal working hours.
steps: Go to Gate Pass → Create New Request → select date, time out, time in (if returning), state the purpose.
If not returning the same day (e.g. leaving early for good), Time In can be left blank.
Click Create → Submit.
Direct manager approves at level 1, HR gives final approval — same flow as Leave Request.

vehicleHelp.title: Vehicle Booking
vehicleHelp.intro: Use this to book a company vehicle for work purposes.
steps: Go to Vehicle Booking → Create New Booking → select date, time, departure/destination, purpose, number of people.
Click Create → Submit.
Direct manager approves at level 1.
Admin (vehicle dispatch) gives the final approval — unlike Leave/Overtime/Gate Pass, where HR gives final approval.

purchaseHelp.title: Purchasing (2 stages)
purchaseHelp.intro: The purchasing process has 2 separate, sequential stages: (1) Purchase Requisition — no pricing yet, (2) Priced PR — Purchaser fills in pricing after Stage 1 is approved.
steps: Stage 1 — Purchase Requisition: go to "Requisition" → Create New → enter reason, add item lines needed (no pricing) → Submit.
Direct manager approves at level 1, the Board of Directors gives the final approval.
Once approved, the system automatically emails the Purchaser — the Purchaser goes to "Priced PR" → Create New → selects the approved requisition → fills in unit prices for each line.
Stage 2 — Priced PR: Direct manager approves at level 1, the Accountant gives the final approval.

If the total exceeds 2,000 USD: the system requires the manager to check a confirmation that they have "emailed the Board of Directors for approval" before approving in the system — this is an email step done outside the system, not a separate approval level.
Once the Priced PR is approved, the system does NOT automatically create a Purchase Order (PO) — the Purchaser contacts the supplier directly and records it manually (on paper).

myApprovalsHelp.title: My Approvals
myApprovalsHelp.intro: Gathers everything awaiting your approval from 6 different parts of the system into one place — no need to check each page one by one.
steps: Click "My Approvals" in the menu (the red number shows how many items are pending).
Items are grouped by type (Leave, Overtime, Purchase...), with the longest-waiting ones at the top.
Items waiting 3+ days show the day count in red — handle those first.
Click any row to jump straight to that item and approve/reject as usual.
Note: items you created yourself won't appear here, since you cannot approve your own requests.

scan.title: QR Scan Stocktake
scan.intro: First start a stocktake session for the correct warehouse on the Stocktake page. Then use your phone for fast counting without manually searching for lots.
steps: Make sure a stocktake session is already open for the correct warehouse (start it on the Stocktake page on a computer).
Open this page on your phone's browser and allow Camera access.
Point the camera at the QR tag on the lot — the system automatically finds the right line to count.
Enter the actual counted quantity → Confirm — the camera automatically resumes to scan the next lot.
If scanning fails (damaged tag, poor light), use the manual lot ID entry field.

permissions.title: Permissions — Who Can Do What
permissions.intro: Each Warehouse belongs to one managing Department; each user also belongs to one Department. Actions affecting a specific warehouse are blocked if the department doesn't match — except for Admin (always allowed).
roles: Full access, bypasses all department checks
Warehouse staff — operates within their own department's warehouse
Department Head — approves issue requests at level 1
Board of Directors — final approval level for issue requests
Can only create issue requests, cannot approve anything
moduleRules: No department check — any WAREHOUSE_STAFF can edit for any warehouse
Checked against the department managing the RECEIVING warehouse
No department check — QC_MANAGER can approve for any warehouse
Level-1 approval checks the REQUESTER's department; releasing stock checks the ISSUING warehouse's department
Ship confirmation checks the SOURCE warehouse's department; receive confirmation checks the DESTINATION warehouse's department
Every action requires the correct department managing that warehouse — the strictest rule in the system. Tolerance override is Admin-only

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
items: Why can't I create a document for a certain warehouse?
Check whether you belong to the department that manages that warehouse — only staff from the matching department can operate on it (except Admin).
Why won't QC let me submit?
You must have at least one photo and a selected result before submitting.
What happens if there isn't enough stock to issue?
The system still issues whatever is available instead of blocking the entire request — check the actual issued quantity in the request detail.
Where do I change the language?
Click the VI / EN / 中文 button in the top-right corner of any page — your choice is remembered for next time.

roleDuties.ADMIN: Full system access — create/edit/delete any data, manage accounts, bypass all department checks. The only role that can override stocktake results when tolerance is exceeded.
roleDuties.WAREHOUSE_STAFF: Handles daily operations for your department's warehouse: create and submit goods receipts, release stock once approved, confirm ship/receive for warehouse transfers, start and perform stocktakes.
roleDuties.QC_MANAGER: Approves or rejects quality inspection results for any lot in any warehouse — not limited by department.
roleDuties.DEPT_HEAD: Gives level-1 approval for issue requests created by staff in your own department.
roleDuties.BOD: Gives the final approval for any issue request, after Department Head approval — not limited by department.
roleDuties.REQUESTER: Creates issue requests for your own needs — no approval rights or direct stock actions.
